_comment: Shown to users in the 'What's new' sheet after an update, and at the top of the GitHub release notes. Newest release first. Write for listeners, not developers: what they can do now, in a sentence or two. type is new, improved or fixed.

highlights.title: Settings, all in one place
highlights.text: Tap the gear on Home to manage your folders, library filters, sleep timer and sound settings.

highlights.title: Pull down to refresh
highlights.text: Added new music? Pull down on Home or Songs and Muzik finds it right away.

highlights.title: Play by voice
highlights.text: Ask Google Assistant or Android Auto to "play" an artist, album or song on Muzik.

highlights.title: About Muzik
highlights.text: See which version you have, get the latest one, or tell us about a bug in a couple of taps.

highlights.title: Up to date under the hood
highlights.text: Muzik is now built on the latest Android libraries, so it keeps working well on new phones.
